Happy to help, and good luck with the applications. The usual culprits are pasted text carrying its own formatting, a section break with different margins, and a mismatched style. Try this:

1. Select all (Ctrl+A), then Paste Special > Keep Text Only, or clear formatting (Ctrl+Space in Word).
2. Layout > Margins > pick one preset (1" all around) and set 'Apply to: Whole document'.
3. Home > Styles > right-click Normal > Modify, set your font and size (e.g. Calibri 11), and tick 'New documents based on this template' if you want it saved.
4. Delete any hidden section breaks: turn on the ¶ button and delete lines that say 'Section Break'.

If you paste the letter text I can check it for stray formatting and tidy it.

Checklist:
- Select all > clear formatting
- Paste as plain text
- Margins: 1", whole document
- Modify Normal style: one font, one size
- Delete stray section breaks (show ¶)
- Save as PDF to lock the layout before sending

Good luck with the applications.
